purpose: Hindi railway information sources for research crawling

web_search_sources.description: Sources to use with the Web News research pipeline. These are discovered through search/RSS/article pages rather than the RSB zone crawler.

sources.name: PIB Hindi
search_keywords: site:pib.gov.in भारतीय रेलवे हिंदी प्रेस विज्ञप्ति
sources.notes: Official Hindi railway/ministry releases. Listing is all-ministry (Railways = ddlMinistry id 23, reachable only via ASP.NET postback), so railway releases are sparse; relevance filter selects them. PressReleaseDetail.aspx is a JS shell - use PressReleasePage/IframePage.
sources.crawler_notes: direct: RSS gives PressReleaseIframePage PRID links (server-rendered)

sources.name: Live Hindustan Indian Railways
sources.notes: Good Hindi railway tag page with recent local and national railway updates.

sources.name: Amar Ujala Indian Railways
sources.notes: Good Hindi railway tag page. Article extraction may need site-specific selectors.

sources.name: AajTak Indian Railways
sources.notes: High-volume Hindi railway topic page. Pages can be heavier and may need cleanup.

sources.name: Navbharat Times Railway
sources.notes: Hindi railway news listing from Navbharat Times.

rsb_sources.description: Sources for the Official Railway / RSB research pipeline. research/rsb_pipeline.py rewrites the listing URL to lang=1 (Hindi); config.ZONES uses lang=0 (English). Hindi coverage is NOT uniform across zones - measured 2026-08-31, see hindi_coverage.

sources.name: Northern Railway Press Releases
sources.notes: Hindi titles, but bodies are usually English. Use body_hindi_ratio to filter.

sources.name: Central Railway Press Releases
sources.notes: Full Hindi edition at lang=1 - titles and bodies both Devanagari.

sources.name: Western Railway Press Releases
sources.notes: Full Hindi edition at lang=1 - titles and bodies both Devanagari.

sources.name: Indian Railways Hindi Magazine
sources.notes: Official Indian Railways Hindi magazine page. Useful for Hindi terminology, but not directly handled by crawler.py because it is not a zone press-release listing.

hindi_coverage_measured_2026_08_31._note: ECoR/SCR publish an unfilled Hindi template; the zone has not translated its releases.
